92331419ff1932a9.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking a Quality and Safety Officer to ensure the effective implementation and continuous monitoring of Safety Management Systems (SMS) and Quality Management Systems (QMS) at Gateway Facilities. This full-time role is based at Riyadh Airport, with required monthly visits to Dammam Airport and designated MODON industrial warehouses in Khamis Mushayt, Hail, and Medina. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide Quality and Safety coverage from the assigned base location at Riyadh Airport. Extend Quality and Safety support to Dammam Airport and designated MODON industrial warehouses through planned monthly visits. Ensure consistent implementation, monitoring, and follow-up of Safety and Quality requirements across assigned locations. Ensure compliance with GACA regulations, company policies, and applicable aviation safety and quality standards. Support the effective implementation and continuous improvement of the SMS and QMS. Promote a positive safety and quality culture across Gateway Facilities. Planning and Internal Control Participate in safety and quality planning activities, including objectives, programs, and performance indicators. Assist in the development and maintenance of safety and quality manuals, procedures, and work instructions. Support risk assessment and hazard identification activities. Conduct internal inspections and compliance monitoring in line with approved inspection plans. Monitor corrective and preventive actions to ensure timely and effective closure. Verify compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. Administration and Reporting Manage safety reports, non-conformities, and quality findings. Coordinate investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes. Maintain safety and quality records and documentation. Prepare and submit safety and quality reports, statistics, and performance summaries to management and relevant authorities as required. Track safety and quality trends and provide recommendations for improvement. Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) and Business Continuity Support the implementation of EHS policies and procedures. Monitor workplace health, safety, and environmental compliance. Promote awareness of EHS requirements and best practices. Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of business continuity and emergency response plans. Participate in drills, exercises, and post-exercise evaluations. Ensure safety and quality considerations are integrated into continuity planning. Performance Indicators The successful candidate will be expected to abide by the goal-setting forms (Individual KPIs) of the current financial year.

Developing and maintaining client relationships. Identifying new business opportunities within the Saudi Arabian market. Contributing to the overall growth and market presence of MSI Qatar in the region. Candidate Requirements Must hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering. Experience level: 0-1 years. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Candidates with 2 to 3 years of experience in the Shutdown, Maintenance, or Services field will also be considered. Required Skills and Attributes Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Demonstrated ability to understand and interpret technical information. A professional and positive attitude towards work and colleagues. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will work as part of the MSI Qatar team, contributing to their operations and market expansion in the region. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are invited to apply for this Sales and Marketing Engineer position with MSI Qatar.

924e23745c5eafb0.description: Overview of the Role NES Global Talent is seeking a qualified Document Controller – SMP with Saudi Aramco. This full-time position is based in Dhahran and requires 0-1 years of experience. The role provides comprehensive administrative support to ensure the smooth daily operation of the office, encompassing clerical, logistical, and communication responsibilities. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external interactions. Manage all incoming and outgoing mail by sorting, logging, and distributing correspondence. Handle telephone inquiries and visitor reception with professionalism. Draft and type various forms of correspondence, reports, and official documents. Create and maintain accurate filing systems, records, and indices to ensure information accessibility. Maintain timekeeping records. Operate office machinery. Monitor office supplies to guarantee operational continuity. Perform any other clerical or miscellaneous duties as directed by the supervisor. The role involves working within an office environment, providing essential administrative functions. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this Document Controller position.

9250415ce7c12245.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Civil Engineer with over 10 years of experience to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting the successful delivery of a major development program that includes extensive civil engineering assets such as road networks, utilities, drainage systems, grading works, and public realm enhancements. The role focuses on ensuring civil infrastructure works are delivered safely, efficiently, and in compliance with project specifications and international standards. Role Context and Contribution The Civil Engineer will be a key member of the PMCM team, responsible for the review, coordination, construction supervision, and delivery of civil infrastructure works. This role requires providing technical expertise and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, consultants, and stakeholders to manage complex infrastructure packages while maintaining quality, cost, and schedule objectives. The work contributes to the Kingdom's long-term urban development and sustainability goals. Key Responsibilities Review and assess civil engineering designs, drawings, specifications, calculations, and technical submissions for infrastructure and landscape projects. Provide technical oversight and construction supervision of civil works to ensure compliance with approved designs and project requirements. Support the delivery of roads, utilities, drainage systems, earthworks, grading, public realm infrastructure, and associated civil engineering assets. Review contractor shop drawings, material submissions, method statements, temporary works proposals, and construction methodologies. Conduct site inspections and monitor construction progress to verify quality, safety, and compliance with project standards. Coordinate with structural, mechanical, electrical, irrigation, utilities, BIM, and landscape teams for seamless project integration. Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, risk evaluations, value engineering workshops, and technical coordination meetings. Identify design conflicts, construction challenges, site constraints, and technical risks, recommending effective engineering solutions. Monitor contractor performance and provide technical input on schedule adherence, quality control, and project milestones. Support testing, inspection, commissioning, and handover activities related to civil infrastructure assets. Ensure compliance with local regulations, project specifications, international engineering standards, and PMCM governance requirements. Prepare technical reports, engineering assessments, inspection records, review comments, and project documentation. Support stakeholder engagement activities with clients, contractors, consultants, and authorities to facilitate project delivery. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and promote engineering excellence throughout the project lifecycle. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum of 10 to 15 years of experience in civil engineering, construction supervision, or infrastructure project delivery. Proven experience working on major infrastructure, utilities, transportation, public realm, landscape, or urban development projects. Strong knowledge of civil engineering principles including roads, drainage, utilities, earthworks, grading, pavement design, and site development works. Experience reviewing engineering drawings, specifications, technical reports, construction methodologies, and contractor submissions. Familiarity with international engineering codes and standards, as well as local authority requirements applicable to infrastructure projects. Experience supporting construction supervision, quality assurance, testing, inspection, and project handover activities. Proficiency in engineering software and tools such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, BIM platforms, and relevant civil engineering applications. Strong understanding of construction processes, contract requirements, risk management, and health and safety regulations. Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within PMCM, engineering consultancy, owner representative, or client-side organizations is highly desirable. Previous experience on GCC infrastructure projects, particularly in Saudi Arabia and large-scale masterplanned developments, is preferred. Professional registration or membership with recognized engineering institutions is advantageous.

925de54b920ef080.description: About Noon Noon is developing an ecosystem of digital products and services designed to support daily life across the Middle East. The company focuses on delivering scalable and customer-centric solutions with a mission to serve every door, every day. Noon aims to redefine technological capabilities within the region. About the Role Noon is seeking a Business Development Executive for Noon Payments to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves driving merchant acquisition and transaction growth by identifying leads, pitching tailored payment solutions, and closing deals. The Executive will also manage merchant onboarding and support, while maintaining accurate records and market insights. Key Responsibilities Identify new business opportunities and generate, prospect, and qualify merchant leads through various channels including cold calling, LinkedIn, networking events, industry connections, and bank referrals. Present Noon Payments' solutions to merchants, assess their business requirements, and prepare customized commercial proposals. Drive merchant acquisition across multiple key sectors. Negotiate commercial terms and finalize deals in alignment with company objectives, pricing guidelines, and revenue targets. Collect necessary merchant documentation and coordinate with Operations, Product, Risk, Compliance, and Technical teams to ensure smooth onboarding and activation. Proactively follow up with newly onboarded merchants to ensure go-live, transaction processing, and growth in payment volumes. Manage day-to-day merchant requests, coordinate CRM tickets, and follow up with internal teams for timely resolution. Achieve monthly and quarterly targets for new merchant acquisition, signed and activated merchants, transaction volumes (GMV), and revenue. Maintain an accurate and current CRM pipeline, sales forecasts, merchant records, and regular business performance reports. Monitor market developments, competitor activities, pricing trends, and emerging payment solutions. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess high standards and a strong work ethic. Resourcefulness and a bias for action are essential. The role requires individuals who demonstrate originality and adaptability, with a readiness to pivot and learn in a dynamic environment.

92a0f8f8f75bf2e8.description: About the Role Airbus Americas, Inc. is seeking an Engineer III to join their team in Al Qatif. This full-time position involves performing technical qualifications for aircraft parts and developing engineering inputs for technical specifications. The role focuses on ensuring the qualification of Cabin & Cargo Standard Parts according to applicable Airbus engineering procedures. Key Responsibilities Develop engineering project plans in collaboration with various stakeholders. Coordinate all activities within technical qualification projects. Provide engineering analysis and supporting documentation for Qualification Test Plans, Qualification Test Reports, and compliance documentation. Interface with stress engineers, designers, suppliers, and technical management to ensure product qualification meets industry and airworthiness standards. Resolve technical engineering problems, consulting with specialists as needed, to mitigate impacts on performance, cost, or schedule. Contribute technical input to engineering project teams and design engineering elements of integrated project plans to ensure technical robustness. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field. A minimum of 5 years of experience in the aerospace industry. Experience with project management techniques and coordinating new program and product development. Proficiency in detail part testing, including static strength, service life, and corrosion resistance. Familiarity with industry testing standards such as NASM, ATSM, and DO-160. Knowledge of metallic and non-metallic parts manufacturing processes and associated industry standards. Experience with metallic material surface protection processes and applicable industry standards. Understanding of metallic and non-metallic material mechanical properties. Application of international aerospace regulatory requirements, including FAA / EASA Part 21, Part 25, or TSO standards. Work Environment and Travel This role permits up to 20% telework. The position also requires up to 20% domestic and international travel for business meetings and training sessions.

92a623c77c5df427.description: About the Role Ericsson is seeking a Charging Support Engineer to join the EMEA Networks team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting key Communication Service Provider (CSP) customers, ensuring service availability and performance, and resolving complex incidents. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and is part of the EMEA Service Line Support & Repair, focusing on network stability, SLA fulfillment, and customer satisfaction. Role Context and Collaboration The Charging Support Engineer will work within a team of nearly 4,000 professionals dedicated to driving innovation across diverse markets. This role involves close collaboration with customer operations, Ericsson Global and Market Area support teams, and Product Development Units. The focus will be on charging and connected systems, including IN/SDP, online/offline charging, mediation, and core and billing/CRM interfaces. Key Responsibilities Support Ericsson Charging in live customer networks, resolving incidents, problems, and service requests within agreed SLAs, including root-cause analysis and documentation. Analyze logs, protocols, signaling, transactions, and call flows across charging nodes and connected systems to identify failures and isolate faults end-to-end. Execute workarounds, configuration changes, and corrective actions following Ericsson processes and customer change management. Perform health checks, monitoring, and performance analysis; identify risks and recurring issues, and drive preventive actions for stability and customer experience. Maintain problem records and knowledge-base articles; participate in major-incident RCA and follow through on corrective and preventive actions. Support software updates, patches, and hot fixes through impact checks, test/pre-production validation, implementation support, and post-change follow-up. Collaborate with Global Support, Market Area teams, and Product Development Units on complex tickets, escalations, and product defects. Analyze capacity, performance, and stability; recommend improvements and present incident trends, risks, and service actions in customer reviews. Contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and best-practice sharing. Adhere to Ericsson security, compliance, quality, service-delivery, health, and safety requirements, as well as customer site rules. Work Environment and Schedule This role may require participation in on-call/standby and 24/7 shifts, including weekends and public holidays, as needed and in line with business requirements and local regulations. The position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time commitment. Experience Required A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a relevant field.

92fc581825620714.description: About the Role Tabby is seeking an AM Retention Specialist to join the Merchant Operations team. This full-time role focuses on addressing operational issues for live merchants in KSA and implementing retention strategies for merchants considering deactivation. The AM Retention team operates independently with its own queue and key performance indicators, working in conjunction with the Onboarding team. Key Responsibilities Manage the AM Retention ticket queue, ensuring all escalations are resolved within service level agreements (SLAs). Configure and modify merchant accounts within the Back Office system, including payment links, API checkout integrations, store and dashboard names, payout cycles, and platform changes. Handle merchant contracts by issuing new agreements at existing rates, tracking missing contracts, and updating legal entities. Process cross-border requests for KSA/UAE and facilitate the addition of new merchant branches. Address deactivation requests by identifying the underlying reasons (*, Tabby Card, rates, KYB documents, low usage) and implementing retention efforts. Escalate Tier 1, Tier 2, or non-standard cases to the appropriate Account Manager or deal owner, providing comprehensive context. Collect Know Your Business (KYB) documents from merchants and collaborate with the Compliance team to ensure adherence to regulatory standards. Maintain accurate and current records in the CRM and ticket notes for all cases. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Ability to accurately and quickly resolve operational issues. Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on merchant retention. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Tabby's Merchant Operations department, specifically supporting the AM Retention team. The role involves managing a dedicated queue and contributing to specific KPIs.

92b1100950b1471e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اقوات للصناعات الغذائية عن مشغل آلة تعبئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة وصيانة آلات التعبئة لضمان جودة وسلامة المنتجات الغذائية المصنعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل آلات التعبئة ومراقبتها بشكل مستمر، مع التحقق من مطابقة المنتج للمواصفات الفنية المحددة. تنظيف المعدات بانتظام وأداء مهام الصيانة الأساسية، بالإضافة إلى الإبلاغ عن أي أعطال أو مشكلات فنية لفنيي الصيانة أو الميكانيكيين المختصين. الاحتفاظ بسجل دقيق ومفصل لجميع أعمال الصيانة والإصلاحات المنجزة على الآلات. الالتزام الصارم بجميع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. القيام بعمليات تفتيش روتينية للصيانة الوقائية للكشف عن أي أضرار أو تلفيات محتملة في أجزاء الآلات، وتحديد المشاكل واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تنفيذ إجراءات الاختبار للتأكد من أن الآلات تعمل على النحو الأمثل وبكفاءة عالية خلال عملية الإنتاج. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تشغيل الآلات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع الصناعات الغذائية. القدرة على فهم وتشغيل المعدات الصناعية بكفاءة. القدرة على تحديد المشكلات الفنية الأساسية واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية المناسبة. المهارات والكفاءات الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مصنع شركة اقوات للصناعات الغذائية بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل في بيئة صناعية تتطلب الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة.

9272a3961e46b77f.description: About the Role RAWAJ, a legal consultancy and law firm in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an Executive Secretary to join its team. This full-time role involves providing direct administrative and executive support to the Board of Directors, ensuring efficient coordination and handling of confidential information within an environment that values accuracy and effective communication. Role Overview The Executive Secretary will be responsible for supporting the Board of Directors by managing meeting logistics, maintaining proper documentation, and handling sensitive legal and business correspondence. The position requires timely follow-up on Board decisions and ongoing assignments to ensure smooth operations and effective support for senior executives. Key Responsibilities Manage and organize executive correspondence, Board documents, and confidential legal files. Support senior executives in meeting preparation, decision follow-up, and business coordination. Handle and organize contracts, reports, and administrative documents related to executives and the Board of Directors. Provide administrative and executive support to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Coordinate and monitor ongoing assignments and projects, ensuring timely progress and reporting. Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, presentations, and reports, and follow up on agreed actions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in an executive secretarial or administrative support role. Demonstrated ability to manage confidential information with discretion. Proven organizational skills and attention to detail. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a legal consultancy and law firm committed to providing professional legal services. The firm supports its clients through legal advice, representation, and tailored business solutions, emphasizing confidentiality, accuracy, and effective coordination. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9280ed3a9524513f.description: نبحث عن مندوب مبيعات متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في نمو أعمالنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تحقيق أهداف المبيعات، بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، وتقديم حلول مبتكرة تلبي احتياجاتهم. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شغفاً بالمبيعات، وقدرة على العمل تحت الضغط، فنحن ندعوك للتقدم لهذه الفرصة . موقع العمل: المنطقة الشرقية – المنطقة الغربية – المنطقة الجنوبية 05******** المهام والمسؤوليات: * تحقيق وتجاوز أهداف المبيعات الشهرية والربع سنوية. * تطوير استراتيجيات مبيعات فعالة لزيادة قاعدة العملاء. * تقديم عروض تقديمية مقنعة للمنتجات والخدمات. * بناء والحفاظ على علاقات قوية وطويلة الأمد مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين. * تحليل اتجاهات السوق والمنافسين لتقديم رؤى قيمة. * معالجة استفسارات العملاء وحل أي مشاكل قد تنشأ. * التعاون مع فرق التسويق والإنتاج لضمان رضا العملاء.

92893b02f5f17a93.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الهلالي للتجاره والمقاولات عن مشرف تصنيع للانضمام إلى فريقها في العقيق، الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على عمليات التصنيع، بدءاً من دراسة خصائص المواد وحتى متابعة برامج الصيانة، لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام الرئيسية يتولى مشرف التصنيع مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام الحيوية لضمان جودة وكفاءة عمليات الإنتاج، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: دراسة خصائص ومواصفات المواد الأولية والمضافة والوسيطة والمنتجات الصناعية، واقتراح التحسينات اللازمة. متابعة تركيب أجهزة ومعدات وحدات التصنيع وفقاً للمخططات التوزيعية المعدة من قبل المهندس الصناعي. متابعة إجراءات تجهيز وتشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات الإنتاجية بحسب تعليمات الشركات الصانعة، وضبط الظروف التشغيلية. متابعة خطط الإنتاج ودراسة نتائج التحاليل المخبرية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة وحل المشكلات الفنية التي قد تطرأ. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لأجهزة ومعدات وحدات الإنتاج الصناعي بالتنسيق مع الأقسام المعنية بالصيانة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل الخاصة بوحدات الإنتاج الصناعية. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخبرة والمعرفة اللازمة للإشراف على عمليات التصنيع بكفاءة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بالتصنيع أو الإشراف على الإنتاج. القدرة على فهم ودراسة خصائص ومواصفات المواد المختلفة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة المعدات الصناعية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة العقيق بمنطقة الباحة، وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف المباشر على عمليات التصنيع وضمان سيرها بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

92e4dbe4ee99c7f5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تركي بن مقرن للمقاولات عن مشغل مضخة مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتطلب هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل بجوار سد الشفيق في قرية الشقيق، مع اشتراط أن يكون سكن المتقدم لا يبعد أكثر من 10 كيلومترات عن موقع العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد مضخة المياه بشكل دوري وفقاً للجدول الزمني المحدد. التحقق من جاهزية المضخة وتوافر المياه اللازمة للتشغيل. فتح صمامات المدخل والمخرج لضمان تدفق المياه بشكل صحيح. تشغيل المضخة بما يتوافق مع خطط العمل المتفق عليها. مراقبة أداء المضخة باستمرار لضمان كفاءتها. تنفيذ برنامج الصيانة الوقائية لمضخة مياه السد للحفاظ على عملها. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تشغيل وصيانة مضخات المياه. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على فهم آليات عمل المضخات وتنفيذ مهام الصيانة الأساسية. متطلبات الموقع يقع موقع العمل بجوار سد الشفيق في قرية الشقيق، حائل. يشترط أن يكون سكن المتقدم لا يبعد عن موقع العمل بمسافة تزيد عن 10 كيلومترات لضمان سهولة الوصول والالتزام بجدول العمل. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمهام التشغيل والصيانة المحددة لضمان استمرارية عمل مضخة المياه بكفاءة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة تركي بن مقرن للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

92e6af19969229f3.description: About PetroApp PetroApp provides fuel payment and fleet control solutions for businesses across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Nigeria, and Thailand. The platform enables drivers to pay with NFC at partner stations, while fleet managers can set limits and monitor transactions in real time. The system also incorporates fraud checks to prevent unauthorized transactions. PetroApp is expanding its offerings beyond fuel to include vehicle services, a consumer application for car owners, and additional tools for partner stations. The Product Manager Role As a Product Manager at PetroApp, you will manage product areas from problem identification through to post-release measurement. Given that most product shipments involve real payments at physical stations, both quality and speed are critical. The specific product area will be assigned based on individual strengths and company needs. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage a problem area comprehensively, covering discovery, definition, delivery, and post-launch results. Engage with daily users of PetroApp, including fleet managers, finance teams, drivers, station staff, and car owners. Conduct on-site visits to stations and customer locations as required for insights. Translate insights into clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering teams. Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Operations, Customer Support, Sales, and Marketing to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery. Prioritize the product backlog based on user and business impact, providing clear justifications for trade-offs. Lead sprint planning and refinement sessions with the team, and proactively resolve blockers to maintain delivery pace. Define success metrics before development and track them post-launch, including self-service data extraction when necessary. Plan for real-world edge cases such as failed payments, offline stations, fraud attempts, regulatory compliance, and country-specific differences. Monitor competitor activities and identify relevant market trends. Required Qualifications and Skills Demonstrated experience shipping at least one mobile or web product or feature, with the ability to discuss its outcomes, including challenges encountered. Proficiency with data: capable of defining metrics, interpreting dashboards, and questioning data insights. SQL knowledge is an advantage. Strong written communication skills, producing concise and unambiguous specifications, tickets, and updates. Experience working within agile methodologies (Scrum or Kanban). A solid understanding of UX fundamentals and experience collaborating closely with designers. Ability to design solutions for diverse user groups, ranging from finance managers in office settings to drivers and station staff on the forecourt. Work Environment and Impact This role offers direct ownership of problems that influence how businesses and drivers manage fuel payments and vehicle operations. The position involves working across various domains, including payments, NFC-based transactions, fraud prevention, and data management. PetroApp fosters a fast-paced, practical team environment where shipping products and learning from them are prioritized. There is direct access to product leadership and a clear path for career progression to a senior role. The impact of this role is measurable through metrics such as money saved, fraud prevented, and efficiency gains for fleet teams.

928fca625f23acca.job_title: Senior Executive Manager Cyber Security Strategy & Architecture
928fca625f23acca.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Senior Executive Manager - Cyber Security Strategy & Architecture to join their team in Jeddah. This role is central to designing cybersecurity standards, enabling Bupa Arabia to grow and transform its business with security integrated from the outset. The position is a full-time employee role requiring 8-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Draft and maintain the cybersecurity strategy in alignment with business priorities, risk appetite, and CISO direction. Build and maintain a multi-year roadmap, defining investment priorities, outcomes, dependencies, and owners. Monitor external threats, regulatory changes, and technology landscapes to recommend strategic adjustments. Develop and maintain target-state security architecture, technical standards, and reference patterns across all environments. Conduct design-stage architecture reviews for major initiatives and security engineering changes. Assess architecture exceptions and technical debt, escalating material exceptions for risk review and CISO approval. Apply cybersecurity requirements and architecture guardrails to transformation, technology planning, and delivery projects. Collaborate with business, technology, data, cloud, and procurement teams to shape secure solution options early. Recommend cybersecurity initiative and investment priorities based on business value, risk reduction, and architectural fit. Manage the delivery of prioritized cybersecurity initiatives from planning through implementation, in line with the approved strategy. Coordinate delivery teams, partners, and stakeholders, managing scope, milestones, resources, budgets, and risks. Confirm operational handover with Cyber Security Operations, track benefits realization, and escalate material issues to the CISO. Track outcome measures for strategy execution and architecture adoption. Prepare progress reports on strategy delivery, investment performance, and decisions required. Provide strategy and architecture input to the CISO’s leadership, Board, and regulatory reporting. Maintain effective working relationships with technology, risk, business, and subsidiary stakeholders. Engage business and technology stakeholders early to align cybersecurity priorities, roadmaps, and delivery. Coordinate with BISOs across functions and subsidiaries to promote consistent security practices. Review draft cybersecurity policies for technical feasibility and support the CISO in governance forums. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience in cybersecurity strategy and architecture. Demonstrated ability to design and implement cybersecurity standards. Experience in developing and maintaining multi-year roadmaps and investment priorities. Proficiency in enterprise security architecture and technical standards. Strong understanding of cybersecurity requirements within transformation and technology projects. Proven track record in managing the delivery of cybersecurity initiatives. Experience in performance tracking, insights generation, and executive reporting for cybersecurity programs. Capability to manage and engage diverse stakeholders across various functions. The successful candidate will work within a dynamic environment focused on integrating robust cybersecurity measures into business growth and transformation initiatives.

92e7f00a9d361752.description: About FxPro FxPro is an international fintech company with offices in Limassol, London, Nassau, Dubai, and Yerevan. The company employs over 600 individuals representing 50 nationalities. FxPro considers each team member an integral part of its operations. The Role of Payment Partnerships Manager FxPro is seeking a Payment Partnerships Manager to join its team. This full-time role is based in Saudi Arabia and requires 2-5 years of experience in payments, specifically within the CFD, forex, online trading, or similar high-risk industries. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing competitor payment offerings, identifying opportunities to enhance payment capabilities, and building relationships with payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers, banks, and local payment providers across key markets. Key Responsibilities Research and monitor competitors in CFD, forex, online trading, and other relevant high-risk sectors to understand payment methods, providers, market coverage, and overall payment offerings. Review and test competitor and market payment solutions to identify strengths, weaknesses, and gaps. Build and maintain a structured database comparing FxPro's payment offering with competitors, including payment methods, geographic coverage, providers, and user experience. Identify and research potential PSPs, acquirers, banks, and local alternative payment providers across target markets. Initiate contact, establish relationships, and manage communications with prospective providers, from initial outreach through commercial negotiations and onboarding. Attend relevant payments, fintech, forex, and online trading events to meet new providers, expand the company's network, and identify potential partnership opportunities. Request and compare proposals, processing fees, transaction limits, reserves, and settlement terms. Evaluate providers based on market coverage, payment methods, commercial viability, technical capabilities, operational reliability, and regulatory requirements. Coordinate due diligence, payment testing, and onboarding with internal teams and external providers to support the launch of new payment solutions. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be proactive, commercially minded, and well-connected within the payments industry. This role combines competitor research, payment analysis, provider sourcing, relationship management, and the testing and implementation of new payment solutions. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in payments within the CFD, forex, online trading, or a similar high-risk industry. Demonstrated ability to analyze competitor offerings and identify improvement opportunities. Proven track record of building and maintaining relationships with payment service providers, acquirers, and banks. Application Process The interview process for this position includes two steps: A screening call with a recruiter (approximately 30 minutes). A technical interview with the Chief Of Operations.

923dc39414cea964.description: About the Role United Motors Company is seeking an Auto Technician to join their team in Abha, Asir. 9253ce1c92631eea.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحلويات الفرنسية العالمية للخدمات التجارية عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بمحاسبة التكاليف وحفظها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى محاسب التكاليف مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان دقة وفعالية إدارة التكاليف، وتشمل هذه المسؤوليات ما يلي: تخطيط ودراسة الأساليب المستخدمة في حساب التكلفة، وتحديد عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة، وحساب التكلفة الإجمالية. تحليل عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة بشكل دوري، وتحديد معدل التكلفة المعيارية، وتحديد الانحرافات ومساهمة كل منها في زيادة أو تقليل التكلفة. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالتكاليف وطرق التسعير، وإعداد التوصيات ورفعها للإدارة لاتخاذ القرارات المناسبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات حساب التكاليف، ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال المحاسبة وحساب التكلفة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بحساب التكاليف، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يتمتع بالخبرة والكفاءة في مجال محاسبة التكاليف، مع التركيز على الجوانب التحليلية والتخطيطية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال محاسبة التكاليف. فهم عميق لمبادئ وأساليب حساب التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتحديد الانحرافات. المهارات المطلوبة لتحقيق النجاح في هذا الدور، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المهارات التالية: مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. إتقان إعداد التقارير المالية والإدارية. القدرة على تطوير وتحسين الإجراءات المحاسبية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم التوصيات للإدارة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في حفظ الوثائق والتقارير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تدعم التطوير المهني المستمر في مجال المحاسبة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

925a57ce9f01217c.description: تعلن مدرسة لنضيء عقولنا العالمية في حي الرائد بالرياض عن حاجتها إلى معلمة لغة إنجليزية لرياض الأطفال، للانضمام إلى فريق يضيء العقول بالتعلّم من الفطرة والتجربة. عن الوظيفة: نطبق في مدرستنا منهج مونتيسوري، والتعليم في هذه الوظيفة يكون باللغة الإنجليزية بشكل كامل داخل الفصل. المهام: تعليم الأطفال باللغة الإنجليزية بالكامل وفق منهج مونتيسوري تهيئة بيئة صفية منظمة ومحفزة تدعم التعلّم الذاتي والاستكشاف تقديم الأنشطة والأدوات التعليمية بما يناسب مرحلة كل طفل ملاحظة نمو كل طفل ومتابعته وتوثيق تطوره التواصل المستمر مع أولياء الأمور العمل بروح الفريق مع زميلاتها في القسم المتطلبات: مؤهل جامعي في الطفولة المبكرة أو اللغة الإنجليزية إتقان اللغة الإنجليزية تحدثاً وكتابة خبرة في تعليم الأطفال سعودية الجنسية حب العمل مع الأطفال، ومهارات تواصل عالية

92a9181cf04456b4.description: About the Role King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz University Hospital is seeking an Internal Medicine Consultant to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves providing comprehensive medical services within the scope of internal medicine, contributing to the hospital's administrative functions, and participating in educational and research initiatives. 92d609cc652fa426.description: About the Role Azure is seeking an Information Technology Engineer to provide on-site IT support and maintain technology infrastructure across residential communities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring the availability and reliability of network systems, security and surveillance systems, and end-user devices, while also delivering timely technical support to employees and residents. Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network devices, including switches, routers, firewalls, and Wi-Fi access points. Monitor network and internet performance, identify connectivity issues, and resolve service disruptions promptly. Operate, monitor, and support security systems, including CCTV cameras, Network Video Recorders (NVRs), access control systems, and gate systems. Install, configure, and maintain end-user devices such as laptops, desktops, printers, and mobile phones. Manage user accounts, email services, and Microsoft 365 access for compound employees. 92f1f45c5607395a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمق المتحدة عن مصمم جرافيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في أحد رفيده، عسير. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير الأفكار والمفاهيم الإبداعية لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة عبر وسائل الجرافيك المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى وضع المخططات العامة وتصميم الإنتاج للمواد الإعلامية المتنوعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التنسيق الفعال مع أصحاب التصميم، سواء كانوا عملاء داخليين أو خارجيين، لفهم الرسالة المستهدفة وتحديد المتطلبات والاتفاق على المنتج النهائي. تطوير مفاهيم تصميم شاملة تلبي احتياجات العميل، وصياغة أسلوب يتوافق مع الصورة والوضع المرغوبين. تقديم المشورة الفنية المتعلقة بمفاهيم التصميم العامة، وتقديم الإرشادات حول المتطلبات الأسلوبية مثل الألوان والصور ونمط النص والمخطط العام، لضمان توصيل الرسالة بفعالية. تسليم المنتجات النهائية للعملاء، وجمع الملاحظات منهم، ثم دمجها في التصميمات عند الضرورة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالمشاريع، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال تصميم الجرافيك. القدرة على تطوير أفكار إبداعية ومفاهيم تصميمية مبتكرة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق مع العملاء والجهات المعنية. إتقان برامج التصميم الجرافيكي ذات الصلة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في أحد رفيده، عسير. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

928f905c26aa405f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كوبر فارما العربية للصناعة عن أخصائي علوم أحياء دقيقة للانضمام إلى فريقها في رابغ، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان تنفيذ أنشطة مراقبة الجودة والتخطيط بكفاءة ووفقًا لمتطلبات السلامة والممارسات المعملية الجيدة (GLP)، مع الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة لتسليم المنتجات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية ضمان توافق جميع الأنشطة المخبرية مع معايير السلامة واللوائح الداخلية للشركة. إجراء الاختبارات الميكروبيولوجية للمنتجات النهائية، المواد الوسيطة، المواد الخام، مواد التعبئة والتغليف، تحليل المياه، واختبارات الاستقرار وفقًا للمواصفات وطرق الاختبار التحليلية ودستور الأدوية. تحضير الأوساط والمحاليل بما يتوافق مع متطلبات الممارسات المعملية الجيدة (GLP) وإجراءات التشغيل القياسية للمختبر (SOP)، وإجراء تحليل التحقق من صحة الطريقة الميكروبية. تخطيط مجال ذي صلة. معرفة قوية بالممارسات المعملية الجيدة (GLP) وممارسات التصنيع الجيدة (GMP). القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق والمساهمة في بيئة عمل تعاونية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات 924b0c7072076668.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة محور الإرادة للدعاية والإعلان عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ وتقييم السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات التسعير المناسبة. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية. وضع برنامج زمني لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق، ووفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول الملائمة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات ذات الصلة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات وأسعار المنافسين. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التسويق في بيئة ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية للشركة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ملخص الدور يتولى أخصائي التسويق مسؤولية شاملة في تحديد الأهداف وتطوير السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، مع الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يشمل الدور أيضاً إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة في مجال التسويق وعرضها وحفظها، مما يساهم في دعم استراتيجيات الشركة التسويقية.

92786ac2a12b18e4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. تتيح الفرصة للمهندس الميكانيكي للمساهمة في مشاريع صناعية متنوعة ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه مسبقاً. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

9240aa94372b4cb2.description: About the Role of Costing Manager Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Costing Manager to lead the costing and profitability analysis of services, departments, and products across its operations. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities spanning both Jeddah and Makkah. The role is central to ensuring accurate cost allocation, developing service line profitability reports, and supporting management in strategic pricing, cost optimization, and decision-making. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update activity-based costing (ABC) and patient-level cost models in alignment with Group methodology. Conduct costing of services, packages, and medical procedures, ensuring accurate allocation of direct and indirect costs. Analyze cost trends across hospitals, service lines, and specialties, identifying areas for improvement. Evaluate cost per patient, doctor, and department, ensuring consistent methodology and transparency. Support the Group Director in preparing cost vs. reimbursement analyses, comparing actual costs against insurance tariffs and self-pay rates. Perform periodic reviews of cost drivers to identify inefficiencies and recommend corrective actions. Conduct profitability analysis by consultant, specialty, payer (insurance/cash), and facility to support pricing and performance improvement decisions. Collaborate with Revenue Cycle, Operations, and Clinical teams to validate revenue and cost data used in profitability reporting. Prepare periodic profitability dashboards and reports, summarizing service line performance for Group Finance and hospital management. Support the Director in identifying and tracking cost optimization initiatives, ensuring delivery of financial improvement targets. Assist in the development of KPIs and benchmarks for cost efficiency and profitability at hospital and departmental levels. Prepare financial feasibility studies and business cases for new services, medical programs, and projects. Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to evaluate the financial impact of new investments or pricing changes. Provide detailed financial insights to support strategic decisions related to expansion, pricing, and resource allocation. Assist in building ROI and payback models for capital investments and strategic initiatives. Support the integration of costing and profitability tools within the Group's ERP (Oracle/SAP) and BI platforms (Power BI, Hyperion). Maintain accurate data interfaces between financial, clinical, and operational systems. Ensure costing and profitability data are timely, accurate, and aligned with Group reporting timelines. Ensure all costing and profitability processes comply with Group policies, IFRS, SOCPA, and CMA/Tadawul requirements. Support internal and external audits by preparing necessary documentation and reconciliations. Work closely with hospital finance teams to train and guide them on costing and profitability tools and methodologies. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of the job. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in costing and profitability analysis. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement activity-based costing (ABC) models. Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle/SAP and BI platforms like Power BI or Hyperion. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position within the Fakeeh Care Group, primarily located in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves collaboration with various internal teams including Revenue Cycle, Operations, and Clinical departments, as well as hospital finance teams.

92d4e12b0301b23a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن فني مكافحة آفات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتنفيذ مهام مكافحة الآفات المختلفة، مع الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفتيش المناطق أو النباتات المصابة لتحديد الآفات المطلوب إزالتها، وتحديد نوع العلاج المناسب، وتقدير المتطلبات والتكاليف اللازمة. تحضير منطقة المعالجة والمواد المستخدمة، وإزالة أي عوائق قد تعترض عملية الرش. نشر التحذيرات الضرورية والتحضير لعملية التعقيم بالتبخير، بالإضافة إلى خلط المواد الكيميائية وفقاً لاحتياجات معالجة الآفات المحددة. وضع المحاليل الكيميائية أو الغازات السامة، أو رشها، ثم التحقق من النتائج وتكرار الإجراءات إذا لزم الأمر لضمان الفعالية. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مكافحة الآفات. القدرة على تحديد أنواع الآفات المختلفة وتطبيق العلاجات المناسبة. معرفة جيدة بالمواد الكيميائية المستخدمة في مكافحة الآفات وطرق خلطها الآمنة والفعالة. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية والبيئية. القدرة على التعامل مع المعدات والأدوات الخاصة بمكافحة الآفات. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل في بيئات متنوعة تتطلب تطبيق إجراءات السلامة المهنية بشكل مستمر. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه. تُشجع الكفاءات التي تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم لهذه الفرصة في شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة.

928666bf1856ee7e.description: Who Are We ❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell 💡 We are looking for a Global Cybersecurity GRC Manager to manage and coordinate cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance activities across the Foodics Group under the direction of the CISO. You will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of the GRC program translating cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory obligations, and business risks into practical controls, clear ownership, measurable remediation plans, and decision-ready reporting. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role working closely with Cybersecurity, Technology, Product, Legal, Privacy, Internal Audit, and business teams across the group, while supporting Foodics Pay cybersecurity compliance activities where required. What you will do 💡 Manage and coordinate the group cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance program under the direction of the CISO, including day-to-day GRC activities, priorities, operating cadence, and continuous improvement initiatives. Conduct, coordinate, and track gap assessments against ISO 27001, SOC 2, NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, KSA PDPL, and other applicable cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory, and contractual requirements. Translate regulatory and framework requirements into practical controls, implementation actions, accountable owners, target dates, and measurable evidence requirements. Maintain the cybersecurity policy framework, including policies, standards, procedures, control owners, supporting evidence, review cycles, approved exceptions, and related governance records. Own and maintain the cybersecurity risk register, facilitate risk assessments, and drive follow-up on treatment plans, risk acceptance, and overdue actions with business and technology owners. Monitor control implementation and remediation progress, challenge weak or incomplete responses, and escalate material risks, recurring gaps, and overdue actions when necessary. Coordinate internal audits, external audits, customer cybersecurity due diligence, certification activities, and readiness assessments, ensuring requests and evidence are handled consistently and efficiently. Support Foodics cybersecurity compliance activities where required, including control mapping, evidence coordination, remediation tracking, audit support, and management reporting. Prepare cybersecurity GRC dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, risk summaries, compliance status reports, and materials for management and cybersecurity governance committees. Partner with control owners across Technology, Product, Operations, HR, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and other functions to embed cybersecurity requirements into business processes and initiatives. Maintain a clear compliance calendar and ensure recurring assessments, reviews, evidence collection, policy updates, risk reviews, and audit commitments are completed within agreed timelines. Improve the efficiency and quality of the GRC program through standardized templates, control libraries, automation, tooling, and stronger evidence-management practices. What Are We Looking For ❓ Required 10+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, audit, or a closely related field, with demonstrated experience managing enterprise GRC activities and working with senior cybersecurity leadership. Strong hands-on knowledge of ISO 27001 and SOC 2, with practical experience conducting gap assessments, mapping controls, collecting evidence, and driving remediation to closure. Good working knowledge of Saudi cybersecurity and privacy requirements, particularly NCA ECC and KSA PDPL, with the ability to interpret requirements and translate them into actionable controls. Demonstrated experience owning or managing cybersecurity risk registers, risk assessments, treatment plans, risk acceptance, exceptions, and management escalation. Experience maintaining cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, control libraries, control ownership, evidence repositories, and compliance documentation. Proven ability to coordinate internal and external audits, manage evidence requests, respond to customer security assessments, and support certification or assurance readiness. Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex risk and compliance information into clear dashboards, executive summaries, and decision-ready committee reporting. Stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge control owners constructively, drive accountability, and follow actions through to completion. Strong written and verbal communication in English, including the ability to write clear policies, risk statements, assessment findings, remediation actions, and management reports. Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Nice to have Experience working in FinTech, payments, SaaS, or another regulated and technology-driven environment. Experience with SAMA cybersecurity requirements or supporting cybersecurity compliance activities for a regulated payment or financial-services entity. Professional certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CISSP, or equivalent. Experience with PCI DSS, third-party cybersecurity risk management, privacy compliance, or other regional and international security frameworks. Hands-on experience with GRC platforms, evidence automation, compliance tooling, or building structured control and risk reporting workflows. Experience operating across multiple business entities, countries, or regulatory environments. Arabic language skills for engaging with stakeholders, regulators, and documentation. What We Offer You ❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

923d673b08c2a752.description: المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: معرفة التاريخ الصحي والطبي للمستفيد ومتابعة أي تطور أو ما يستجد عليه. تطبيق المقاييس الرسمية والغير رسمية المتبعة داخل الفرع مع جميع للمستفيد وعدم استخدام أساليب تعزيز غذائية مع الحميه. استلام العهد والأدوات والمحافظة عليها. إعداد الوسائل التعليمية بما يخدم البرنامج التدريبي والأنشطة الموجهة. حصر احتياجات البرنامج من وسائل وأدوات وتبليغ المشرف/ة. تسجيل الملاحظات بالسجل اليومي والرد على استفسارات الأهالي بلباقة ومهنية. تدوين الواجبات المنزلية لأولياء الأمور داخل تطبيق زيبرا بوكس مع وصف مبسط يسهل المتابعة للأهل. الالتزام بالرصد 9243f269ed547ee3.description: Role Overview : The organization is a flagship Giga project under Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 initiative, aiming to create a world-class entertainment, cultural and lifestyle destination. As a multibillion-dollar project, it will encompass vast infrastructure development, hospitality, and retail and service sectors, which requires effective and large-scale management of supplier relationships and supply chain risks. The Assistant Manager – Supply Chain Risk is responsible for supporting the organization’s SRM & SCR team on supply chain risk management activities. Supply Chain Risk Management: · Identify potential risks in the supply chain and assess the likelihood and impact of the risks using risk assessment frameworks, (e.g., operational, financial, ESG, compliance, geopolitical, cybersecurity, capacity, and concentration risks). · Develop and maintain supplier risk profiles, including risk scoring, dependency analysis, and critical supplier identification. · Support implementation of mitigation strategies and contingency plans to manage the identified risks and ensure business continuity. · Monitor external factors, such as regulatory changes, natural disasters, or market trends, that could disrupt the supply chain. · Contribute to enterprise‑level risk views and dashboards in alignment with ERM and governance requirements. 2. Internal Stakeholder Engagement: · Collate information from all business teams on their supply chain needs, their supplier’s risk performance to consolidate the organization’s overall supply chain dependencies. · Support awareness sessions for the business teams to learn how to report supplier / supply chain risks to the SRM/SCR team, and to ensure business continuity in case of supply chain disruptions. 3. Team Management, Learning & Development · Oversee and support junior team members, ensuring professional growth through mentorship. · Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture within the SRM & SCR Team. 4. Prepare executive‑ready reports, dashboards, and management updates on key supply chain risk trends and mitigation status.
